criteria.criterion: Six complete reports materially meet the task and principal-quality bar.
criteria.evidence: Six populated UI-authored reports, per-report narrative reviews, desktop/narrow screenshots, supported PPTX/SVG outputs.

criteria.criterion: Reports show task-grounded art direction rather than one repeated template family.
criteria.evidence: A–D use distinct registered task blueprints; fresh E/F blank holdouts have visibly different dense field and sparse decision compositions.

criteria.criterion: Sophisticated reports are produced through supported authoring, without hidden source manipulation.
criteria.evidence: Saved report models, action logs, editor screenshots, Chart Studio/Data First actions, and a clean source tree.

criteria.criterion: Reuse/remix provides obvious leverage without semantic/source leakage.
criteria.evidence: Template-vs-blank actions and maintained CHG-181 pass are present; the additional full benchmark-set reuse/remix challenge was not executed after the P1 stop.

criteria.criterion: Lifecycle/history/conflict recovery remains governed and usable.
criteria.evidence: Canonical save/reload equality for six, report-lifecycle-integrity, native recovery, worker lifecycle, CHG-208, and company-boundary gates pass locally.

criteria.criterion: 390/320 reading has no material clipping, hidden rationale, destructive token wrapping, unreadable diagram, or undiscoverable table overflow.
criteria.evidence: All six at 1440/390; B/D/E at 320; F at 320/360/390. Responsive diagnostics report zero body spill, unclipped narratives, ordered narrow Process Flow, and keyboard/touch table overflow.

criteria.criterion: Editable PPTX preserves visible report meaning, chart family/series/category/y-axis semantics, and dense label/legend/title readability.
criteria.evidence: All category/value caches and chart families are retained, grouped C/E series and y-domains are inspectable, and Box Plots export as editable primitives. However A labelInterval 1 exports tickLblSkip 5 and F 1 exports 2; Quick Look shows only two categories in each. Exact PPTX import round-trip was not run.

criteria.criterion: Wrong-type/missing/ambiguous remap states remain truthful, actionable, and fail closed.
criteria.evidence: Maintained CHG-208 remap diagnostics pass; raw JSON, logs, and screenshots are retained.

criteria.criterion: No new material P0/P1 or world-class composition/reuse failure class is found.
criteria.evidence: R5-FIND-01 is a confirmed P1 low-density editable-PPTX category interval failure after CHG-277.

criteria.criterion: Evidence is complete and independently inspectable.
criteria.evidence: Six reports, raw exports, package XML, hashes, local release/JUnit, responsive captures, finding register, and provenance are included. The full remix challenge and PPTX import round-trip are explicitly blocked after the stop; Quick Look lacks E.
